releases.name: v0.1.0 – Initial release
releases.body:
Initial release of `opencode-subagent-tools`.

Seven tools for OpenCode V2 that give an agent explicit control over its subagent sessions:

- `subagent_list` — discover children and inspect status, cost, and usage.
- `subagent_usage` — read cost, tokens, current context, and optional tree totals.
- `subagent_cancel` — stop one session with a soft interrupt.
- `subagent_cancel_descendants` — stop the caller's running descendants in batches.
- `subagent_steer` — send an instruction at the child's next model request.
- `subagent_queue` — queue a message as the next independent turn.
- `subagent_context` — inject a synthetic context message without starting a turn.

Highlights:

- Discovery through `ctx.session.list`, including nested descendants.
- Text or JSON output per call, with per-tool defaults.
- Permission checks through `subagent.control` and configurable `sessionControlPolicy`.
- Cursor-based pagination for `list` and `cancel_descendants`.
- Bundled `SKILL.md` with operational guidance.
- Configurable discovery, list, cancellation, and text limits.

Requirements: OpenCode 2.2.5+ with `ctx.session.list`.

Install:

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-subagent-tools
```

Or from GitHub:

```sh
opencode plugin add github:finnseefly/opencode-subagent-tools
```

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/finnseefly/opencode-subagent-tools/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

Docs: [README](https://github.com/finnseefly/opencode-subagent-tools#readme)
